query:
SELECT rm.id, rm.name, rm.category 
FROM raw_materials rm 
LEFT JOIN raw_material_molecules rmm ON rm.id = rmm.raw_material_id 
WHERE rmm.raw_material_id IS NULL 
ORDER BY rm.category, rm.name 
LIMIT 50;
